jobs.occupation: Digital Delivery Lead – Azure DevOps & Agile
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Unite multiple agile squads around common objectives and ensure alignment between business priorities and delivery teams.
• Foster team autonomy through servant leadership, providing a clear framework while empowering teams to make decisions.
• Coordinate global planning, manage inter-team dependencies, and arbitrate priorities transparently.

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Data Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key responsibilities

• 
Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq

• 
Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design

• 
Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency

• 
Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team

• 
Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects

• 
Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts

• 
Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory)

• 
Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects

• 
Language skills

• 
Fluent English (written and spoken)

• 
Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration)

• 
Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams

Take over an established portfolio, not a blank page: live accounts, long-term contracts and a clear path to running a full programme.

IT Project Manager | Client Accounts | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating software solutions at its clients’ sites — heavily customised platforms it deploys, tailors and maintains in their environment, often for years.

What makes it stand out? Its accounts sit on long-term framework contracts. You inherit live projects, established relationships and a team that already knows the platforms, rather than starting from scratch.

Part of the technical delivery runs through an external partner, which makes managing the triangle between client, internal teams and partner a core part of the job rather than a side task.

As it grows, the company is looking for a senior IT Project Manager to take over an existing portfolio, with a path towards running a full programme already mapped out internally.

 

The job

• You take ownership of several client accounts: implementations, contractual commitments, budgets, service quality and the relationship with decision-makers.
• You are the point of contact between the client, the internal teams and the technical partner, and you keep a firm grip on the functional content of the work.
 
Role
• Lead implementation and upgrade projects at the client’s site, from scoping through to go-live.
• Manage budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments, arbitrating between what was promised to the client and what the partner can deliver.
• Steer the external partner day to day: capacity, quality of deliverables, deadlines and escalations.
• Work with the business analyst on scoping client needs: challenge requests, measure them against the platform and decide which customisations to retain.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, anticipate contractual and budgetary risks, and bring the difficult trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — integrator, software vendor or consultancy — deploying software solutions at external clients. A purely in-house background on corporate IT projects is not a fit for this role.
• Comfortable with the functional side: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis rather than only coordinate. You also know your way around contractual mechanics, fixed-price and time-and-materials alike.
• Fluent English is essential; diplomacy, administrative rigour and the ability to hold your ground with a demanding client.
